causality.confirmed: The foreground assertion was false after activation of the initial target.
causality.unconfirmed: The captured receipt contains no target inventory, panel context, owned page visibility, or panel focus state at the failing boundary. It cannot distinguish a hidden live panel, a replaced panel target, or a missing side-panel context. It does not prove a product Scrape failure.
causality.fix_decision: No focus behavior, timeouts, visibility assertion, or product code changed without that discriminator.

source_change.effect: On the same foreground failure, record only bounded booleans and counts for the owned root, original panel session visibility/focus, exact panel target identity, and canonical SIDE_PANEL context classification from the owned worker. The aggregate diagnostic deadline reuses the owned CDP transport's configured command timeout. A timed-out receipt records whether probes were still pending; those probes can continue until their individual CDP sends settle or the harness closes its owned connection and child. No Playwright page call can hang this diagnostic. Preserve the original failure and all role, artifact, and resource gates.
source_change.privacy: No credential, account identity, URL, target ID, page text, or screenshot is serialized.

next_evidence: Run one owned member native acceptance with the same frozen artifact and normal 600px request. The new panel_foreground_diagnostic field should identify whether the owned root and original panel target remain present, whether the original panel is hidden, and whether an exact SIDE_PANEL context remains registered.
